caption: The drawing depicts a vintage flat iron with a thick, rectangular base made of metal, rendered in shades of gray and dark brown. The front of the iron shows a rectangular opening or compartment outlined in a darker tone. Attached to the upper part of the iron is a sturdy, curved metal handle support, which holds a wooden handle illustrated in light brown with two engraved rings near each end. The main subject is detailed and shaded, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. Surrounding the central drawing are four smaller, lightly sketched outline drawings, one in each corner of the paper: the top left and bottom right show a side view and a front view of the iron with minimal detail, and the top right and bottom left depict the iron’s soleplate as a simple outlined teardrop or triangular shape. The background is plain with a light beige or off-white color.
title: Flatiron
